nvitk.registration.fsl.points
=============================

.. py:module:: nvitk.registration.fsl.points

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Map voxel indices between images using a FLIRT ``*.mat`` and NIfTI affines.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.registration.fsl.points.load_flirt_matrix
   nvitk.registration.fsl.points.transform_ijk_points_flirt


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: load_flirt_matrix(mat_path: str | pathlib.Path) -> np.ndarray

   Load a 4×4 FLIRT transform (input mm → reference mm).


.. py:function:: transform_ijk_points_flirt(points: np.ndarray, moving_affine: np.ndarray, fixed_affine: np.ndarray, flirt_mat: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray

   Map ``(i,j,k)`` points from moving image voxels to fixed image voxels.

   Uses moving/fixed NIfTI affines and the FLIRT matrix from
   ``flirt -in <moving> -ref <fixed>`` (same as ``tof_to_vwi_bb.mat``).
